newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight sees scant activity.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight sees scant activity.

text.p: CSR have fixed Anangel Eagle 20,000 bulk sugar Queensland-Cigading for May loading at $19.75-20.00.

There was little else new in the sugar markets today except Cargill amended its order from Santos or Paranagua to Egyptian Med, Black Sea, option Baltic for 5-10 May loading , 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar.
Glencore have 13-14,000 tonnes bulk sugar East Coast Mexico to Black Sea or Med for prompt loading.
